title: Jo Haider e Karrar Hai
body:
Jo haider e karrar hai
Jo haidere karaar hai
Woh kul ka madadgar hai
Usse hame bhi pyaar hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Ho naara Ali
Marhab ko do tukde kia
Khaiber ko hatho par rakha
Jibreel dete the sada
<<DIVIDER>>
Mushkil kusha ai mushkil kusha
Maula tumhare waar se katnme lage hai par mere
Mushkil kushai kijiye
Khaiber ho yaa jange jamal
<<DIVIDER>>
Sab mushkilo ka ek hal
Haider ka jo bhi kaam hai
Hayya alaa khairil amal
Maulude kaaba hai Ali
<<DIVIDER>>
Maula ka maula hai Ali
Farmaagae mere nabi
Khud rizq par maamur ho
Daste khuda mashoor ho
<<DIVIDER>>
Jo bhi tumhara laal ho
Usse musibat dur ho
Patthar pe gaadha hai alam
Mohre nabuwat par kadam
<<DIVIDER>>
Kyu na kahu mai dam ba dam
Jo markade afkar hai
Usme Ali paida hua
Jo markaze anwaar hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Usme Ali paida hue
Jo shahe khaibar geer hai
Jiska pisar shabbir hai
Shio tumhara peer hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Shahe arab shahe ajam
Ai malike bade eram
Tere pisar Abbas ki khaae koi juthi kasam
Kisme hai itna hauslaa koi nahi koi naathaa
<<DIVIDER>>
Gaazi ka bhi naara yeh tha
Zauja teri khairunisa
Yani janabe sayyada
Jiske liye tatheer ki aayat me kehta hai khuda
<<DIVIDER>>
Yeh mustufa ka Noor hai
Har riz isse dur hai
Iski khushi manzoor hai
Kuwat hai us darain woh
<<DIVIDER>>
Baatil ke jo kaate jigar
14 Sadi ke baad bhi
Jaari hai naare kaa safar
Har jang ke har maidaan me
<<DIVIDER>>
Bikhre hue tufaan me
Shamil hai yeh imaan me
Nade Ali ka maujiza
Batla gae hai mustafa
<<DIVIDER>>
Haider ka jab kaam aa hi tha
Lab par yahi to thi sada
Ai jaldi aa mere akhi
Hai sakht mushkil ki ghadi
<<DIVIDER>>
Kehne lage jibreel bhi
Hai isme aazam ki sifat
Is naarae bedaar me
Tezi hai isme is kadar
<<DIVIDER>>
Rehti hai jo talwaar me
Dar hai dile kuffaar me
Karta hai dar deewar me
Har kuchao bazaar me
<<DIVIDER>>
Khaake dare shabbir hu
Kadme sukhan ka Noor hu
Maddahe ahlebait hu
Kya sahibe taukeer hu
<<DIVIDER>>
Radde bala ke waaste
Rehan yeh likh dijiye
Mehshar me bakshish ke liye
author: Mir Hassan Mir
